events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Mika Zibanejad tied it late in the third period, and the New York Rangers killed off two penalties in overtime on the way to beating the Philadelphia Flyers 5-4 in a shootout on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers rally from a 2-goal deficit to beat the Flyers 5-4 in a shootout

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Moritz Seider had a goal and an assist and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Washington Capitals 5-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moritz Seider has a goal and an assist, Red Wings beat Capitals 5-2

headlines.description: — Three third-period goals, including a pair from David Perron, powered the Ottawa Senators to a 6-4 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators score 3 goals in third period of 6-4 win over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Matt Boldy scored twice, Filip Gustavsson made 28 saves and the Minnesota Wild beat the Edmonton Oilers 5-2 on Saturday for their seventh straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matt Boldy scores twice, Wild beat Oilers 5-2 for 7th straight victory

events.name: New York Islanders at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Josh Norris got the deciding goal in the shootout and the Buffalo Sabres beat the New York Islanders 3-2 on Saturday for their fifth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Norris gets deciding goal in shootout as Sabres beat Islanders 3-2 for 5th straight win

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — The St. Louis Blues got a pair of goals from Jake Neighbours and Robert Thomas in a 6-2 win over the Florida Panthers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Neighbours and Thomas score twice to lead the Blues over the Panthers 6-2

headlines.description: — Liam Ohgren was the only one to score in a seven-round shootout, and the Vancouver Canucks beat the Boston Bruins 5-4 on Saturday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liam Ohgren gets only score in 7th round of shootout and Canucks rally past Bruins 5-4

headlines.description: — Jacob Fowler made 31 saves for his fourth NHL start for his first shutout and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-0 on Saturday night to open a home-and-home set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob Fowler has 1st NHL shutout, Canadiens send Penguins to 8th straight loss with 4-0 win

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Jake Guentzel scored a pair of third period goals and the Tampa Bay Lightning rallied past the Carolina Hurricanes for a 6-4 victory on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Guentzel scores twice as Lightning rally for 6-4 win over Hurricanes

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Luke Evangelista broke a tie at 9:18 of the third period to help the Nashville Predators beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luke Evangelista breaks 3rd-period tie in Predators' 5-3 victory over the Maple Leafs

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Mikael Backlund scored two goals and the Calgary Flames beat the Vegas Golden Knights 6-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backlund scores 2 as Flames beat Golden Knights 6-3

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Pavel Mintyukov slid a shot from the slot past Elvis Merzlikins with 3:29 left and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pavel Mintyukov scores with 3:29 left to lift Ducks past Blue Jackets, 4-3

events.name: Seattle Kraken at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Ryan Lindgren had the tiebreaking goal early in the third period for his first score with Seattle, and the Kraken beat the San Jose Sharks 4-2 on Saturday night to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lindgren, Stephenson help Kraken beat Sharks 4-2 to snap four-game skid
